newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allots 71.9 bln marks in repo tender at 3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Buba allots 71.9 bln marks in repo tender at 3 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Wednesday it allocated 71.9 billion marks of securities repurchase funds at this week's tender at a fixed rate of three percent, the rate that has prevailed since late August.
A repo pact for 72.9 billion marks at a fixed three percent expires today, Wednesday, so a net one billion marks is flowing out of the market.
The Bundesbank said banks bid for 262.6 billion marks of the repurchase funds this week. It accepted 27.4 percent of the bids.
